## Load Data

```{r}
library(cellpaintr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scater)
library(scran)
library(bluster)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(batchelor)
library(BiocParallel)
library(tidyr)
library(MultiAssayExperiment)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggpubr)
library(viridis)

```

Path to files.

```{r}
# path to files
base <- paste0("/shares/rheumatologie.usz/mimzzzzzzzz/")

files_stress <- c(
  paste0(base, "260915-PLIN2/MyExpt_Cells.csv")
  )
sce <- Reduce(cbind, lapply(files_stress, loadData))

#for lipophagy
base <- paste0("/shares/rheumatologie.usz/mimzzzzzzzz/")

files_stress <- c(
  paste0(base, "260917-Lipophagy_CD/MyExpt_Cells.csv")
  )
sce <- Reduce(cbind, lapply(files_stress, loadData))

# for C75
base <- paste0("/shares/rheumatologie.usz/mimzzzzzzzz/")

files_stress <- c(
  paste0(base, "260925_C75_cytokines/MyExpt_Cells.csv"))
sce <- Reduce(cbind, lapply(files_stress, loadData))

```
Data transformation

```{r}
# remove cells with missing features
sce <- removeNAs(sce)

# remove outlier images
sce <- removeOutliers(sce, min = 1, max = 300)

# remove outlier cells
stats <- perCellQCMetrics(sce, assay.type = "features")
sce <- sce[, !isOutlier(stats$sum)]

# remove features with zero spread
sce <- removeLowVariance(sce, robust = TRUE)

# remove zero-inflated features
sce <- removeZeroInflation(sce)

# transform, center, and scale features
sce <- transformScale(sce, robust = TRUE)

# number of cells
plotCellsPerImage(sce)

```
Pseudo-bulk over images.

```{r}

sce_aggr <- aggregateAcrossCells(
  sce,
  id = colData(sce)[, c("ImageNumber", "Well", "Patient", "Disease")],   
  use.assay.type = "tfmfeatures",
  statistics = "mean"
  )

sce_aggr <- aggregateAcrossCells(
  sce,
  id = colData(sce)[, c("ImageNumber", "Well", "Patient", "Disease", "C75", "Cytokine")],   
  use.assay.type = "tfmfeatures",
  statistics = "mean"
  )


```

#single cell plot / per patient for feature - violin - 1 treatment vs control

```{r}
## ============================================================
## 1. Select features
## ============================================================

all_feature_names <- rownames(
  assay(sce_aggr, "tfmfeatures")
)

my_features <- all_feature_names[
  grepl("PLIN", all_feature_names, ignore.case = TRUE) &            #PLIN
  (
    grepl("MaxIntensityEdge", all_feature_names, ignore.case = TRUE) |
    grepl("RadialDistribution.*3of4", all_feature_names, ignore.case = TRUE) |
    grepl("Granularity_3", all_feature_names, ignore.case = TRUE) |
    grepl("MeanIntensity", all_feature_names, ignore.case = TRUE) |
    grepl("IntegratedIntensity", all_feature_names, ignore.case = TRUE) |
      grepl("RWC", all_feature_names, ignore.case = TRUE) |
    grepl("MassDisplacement", all_feature_names, ignore.case = TRUE) 
  )
]

cat("Selected features:\n")
print(my_features)

all_features <- my_features


## ============================================================
## 2. Choose plotting level
## ============================================================

plot_level <- "cell"
# "cell"    = plot individual cells
# "patient" = average cells within each Patient x Treatment
treatment_to_plot <- "TGFb"

## ============================================================
## 3. Extract feature data
## ============================================================

feature_data <- as.data.frame(
  t(assay(sce_aggr, "tfmfeatures"))
)

feature_data <- feature_data[
  ,
  all_features,
  drop = FALSE
]


## ============================================================
## 4. Extract metadata
## ============================================================

metadata <- as.data.frame(
  colData(sce_aggr)[,
    c(
      "Well",
      "Patient",
      "Treatment"    #,
      #"Disease"
    )
  ]
)


## ============================================================
## 5. Combine metadata + features
## ============================================================

df <- cbind(
  metadata,
  feature_data
)


## ============================================================
## 6. Convert to long format
## ============================================================

df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(all_features),
    names_to = "Feature",
    values_to = "Intensity"
  )


## ============================================================
## 7. Select the main experiment
##
## Condition = NA means:
## keep wells that are NOT labelled as "test"
## ============================================================

df_plot_ready <- df_long %>%
  filter(
    #is.na(Condition),
    Treatment %in% c("control", treatment_to_plot)
  )


## ============================================================
## 8. Patient-level aggregation
## ============================================================

if (plot_level == "patient") {

  df_plot_ready <- df_plot_ready %>%
    group_by(
      Patient,
      Treatment,
      Feature
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      Intensity = mean(
        Intensity,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}


## ============================================================
## 9. Treatment order
## ============================================================

df_plot_ready$Treatment <- factor(
  df_plot_ready$Treatment,
  levels = c(
    "control",
    treatment_to_plot
  )
)


## ============================================================
## 10. Colors
## ============================================================

plot_colors <- c(
  "control" = "#FFD966",   # brighter yellow
   "IL1"     = "#70AD47",  # green
  "TNF"     = "#5B9BD5",  # blue
  "IFNa"    = "#ED7D31",  # orange
  "LPS"     = "#A64D79",  # purple
  "IL6"     = "#00A6A6",  # teal
  "TGFb"    = "#C55A11"   # dark orange
)

## ============================================================
## 11. Output directory
## ============================================================

outdir <- paste0(
  "Flexible_Plots_PLIN_",
  plot_level
)

dir.create(
  outdir,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


## ============================================================
## 12. Loop over features
## ============================================================

for (f in unique(df_plot_ready$Feature)) {

  df_plot <- df_plot_ready %>%
    filter(
      Feature == f
    )


  ## ==========================================================
  ## 13. Statistics
  ## ==========================================================

  if (plot_level == "patient") {

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Paired Wilcoxon test
    # Each Patient has control + IL1
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    stat_result <- df_plot %>%
      pairwise_wilcox_test(
        Intensity ~ Treatment,
        paired = TRUE,
        p.adjust.method = "none"
      )

  } else {

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Cell-level Wilcoxon test
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    stat_result <- df_plot %>%
      pairwise_wilcox_test(
        Intensity ~ Treatment,
        p.adjust.method = "none"
      )
  }


  ## ==========================================================
  ## 14. P-value position
  ## ==========================================================

  stat.test <- NULL

  if (nrow(stat_result) > 0) {

    stat.test <- stat_result %>%
      add_xy_position(
        fun = "max",
        x = "Treatment",
        step.increase = 0.15
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        p.signif = case_when(
          p <= 0.001 ~ "***",
          p <= 0.01  ~ "**",
          p <= 0.05  ~ "*",
          TRUE       ~ paste0(
            "p = ",
            signif(p, 2)
          )
        )
      )
  }


  ## ==========================================================
  ## 15. Plot
  ## ==========================================================

  p <- ggplot(
    df_plot,
    aes(
      x = Treatment,
      y = Intensity,
      fill = Treatment
    )
  ) +

    ## Violin
    geom_violin(
      trim = FALSE,
      alpha = 0.65,
      width = 0.9,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.9
    ) +

    ## Boxplot
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.12,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      fill = "white",
      alpha = 0.4,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    ## Individual observations
    geom_jitter(
  aes(
    fill = Treatment
  ),
  shape = 21,
  color = "black",
  stroke = 0.7,
  width = ifelse(
    plot_level == "patient",
    0.10,
    0.25
  ),
  size = ifelse(
    plot_level == "patient",
    3.2,
    1.8
  ),
  alpha = 0.9
) +

    ## Colors
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = plot_colors
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = plot_colors
    ) +

    ## Labels
    labs(
      title = f,
      y = "Z-scored log intensity",
      x = "Treatment"
    ) +

    ## Theme
    theme_bw(
      base_size = 18
    ) +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 16,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(
        size = 18,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 16
      ),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    ) +

    ## Statistics
    {
      if (
        !is.null(stat.test) &&
        nrow(stat.test) > 0
      ) {

        stat_pvalue_manual(
          stat.test,
          label = "p.signif",
          size = 5,
          tip.length = 0.01,
          bracket.size = 0.6
        )
      }
    }


  ## ==========================================================
  ## 16. Print
  ## ==========================================================

  print(p)


  ## ==========================================================
  ## 17. Save
  ## ==========================================================

  ggsave(
    file.path(
      outdir,
      paste0(
        gsub(
          "[^A-Za-z0-9_]+",
          "_",
          f
        ),
        ".pdf"
      )
    ),
    p,
    width = 6,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```

#single cell plot/per patient - violin - Lipophagy - compare treatment&disease

```{r}
## ============================================================
## 1. Select features
## ============================================================

all_feature_names <- rownames(
  assay(sce_aggr, "tfmfeatures")
)

my_features <- all_feature_names[
  grepl("Lipid", all_feature_names, ignore.case = TRUE) &            
  (
    grepl("MaxIntensityEdge", all_feature_names, ignore.case = TRUE) |
    grepl("RadialDistribution.*3of4", all_feature_names, ignore.case = TRUE) |
    grepl("Granularity_3", all_feature_names, ignore.case = TRUE) |
    grepl("MeanIntensity", all_feature_names, ignore.case = TRUE) |
    grepl("IntegratedIntensity", all_feature_names, ignore.case = TRUE) |
      grepl("RWC", all_feature_names, ignore.case = TRUE) |
    grepl("MassDisplacement", all_feature_names, ignore.case = TRUE) 
  )
]

cat("Selected features:\n")
print(my_features)

all_features <- my_features


## ============================================================
## 2. Choose plotting level
## ============================================================

plot_level <- "cell"
# "cell"    = plot individual cells
# "patient" = average cells within each Patient x Treatment
treatment_to_plot <- c("control", "IL1", "IL6", "TGFb")
diseases_to_plot <- c("OA","RA")

## ============================================================
## 3. Extract feature data
## ============================================================

feature_data <- as.data.frame(
  t(assay(sce_aggr, "tfmfeatures"))
)

feature_data <- feature_data[
  ,
  all_features,
  drop = FALSE
]


## ============================================================
## 4. Extract metadata
## ============================================================

metadata <- as.data.frame(
  colData(sce_aggr)[,
    c(
      "Well",
      "Patient",
      "Treatment",
      "Disease"
    )
  ]
)


## ============================================================
## 5. Combine metadata + features
## ============================================================

df <- cbind(
  metadata,
  feature_data
)


## ============================================================
## 6. Convert to long format
## ============================================================

df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(all_features),
    names_to = "Feature",
    values_to = "Intensity"
  )


## ============================================================
## 7. Select the main experiment
## ============================================================

df_plot_ready <- df_long %>%
  filter(
    Treatment %in% treatment_to_plot,
    Disease %in% c("OA", "RA")
  )

## ============================================================
## 8. Patient-level aggregation
## ============================================================

if (plot_level == "patient") {

  df_plot_ready <- df_plot_ready %>%
    group_by(
      Patient,
      Disease,
      Treatment,
      Feature
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      Intensity = mean(
        Intensity,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

## ============================================================
## 9. Treatment order
## ============================================================

df_plot_ready$Treatment <- factor(
  df_plot_ready$Treatment,
  levels = treatment_to_plot
)

df_plot_ready$Disease <- factor(
  df_plot_ready$Disease,
  levels = c(
    "OA",
    "RA"
  )
)

## ============================================================
## 10. Colors
## ============================================================

plot_colors <- c(
  "control" = "#FFD966",   # brighter yellow
   "IL1"     = "#70AD47",  # green
  "TNF"     = "#5B9BD5",  # blue
  "IFNa"    = "#ED7D31",  # orange
  "LPS"     = "#A64D79",  # purple
  "IL6"     = "#00A6A6",  # teal
  "TGFb"    = "#C55A11"   # dark orange
)
disease_colors <- c(
  "OA" = "#A64D79",
  "RA" = "#5B9BD5"
)
## ============================================================
## 11. Output directory
## ============================================================

outdir <- paste0(
  "Flexible_Plots_Lipid_",
  plot_level
)

dir.create(
  outdir,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


## ============================================================
## 12. Loop over features
## ============================================================
for (f in unique(df_plot_ready$Feature)) {

  ## ==========================================================
  ## 1. Data for this feature
  ## ==========================================================

  df_plot <- df_plot_ready %>%
    filter(
      Feature == f
    )


  ## ==========================================================
  ## 2. Statistics: OA vs RA within each treatment
  ## ==========================================================

stat_result <- df_plot %>% group_by(Disease) %>% 
  pairwise_wilcox_test( Intensity ~ Treatment, 
                        paired = FALSE, p.adjust.method = "none" )

  ## ==========================================================
  ## 3. P-value formatting
  ## ==========================================================

 stat.test <- stat_result %>% 
   mutate( p.signif = case_when( 
     p <= 0.001 ~ "***", 
     p <= 0.01 ~ "**", 
     p <= 0.05 ~ "*", 
     TRUE ~ paste0( "p = ", signif(p, 2) ) ) )

# Get maximum value for each disease 
 y_max <- df_plot %>% group_by(Disease) %>% 
   summarise( ymax = max( Intensity, na.rm = TRUE ), .groups = "drop" ) 
 
 # Add y positions 
 stat.test <- stat.test %>% left_join( y_max, by = "Disease" ) %>% 
   group_by(Disease) %>% mutate( y.position = ymax + row_number() * 0.3 ) %>% ungroup()
 
  ## ==========================================================
  ## 4. Plot
  ## ==========================================================

 p <- ggplot( df_plot, aes( x = Treatment, y = Intensity, fill = Treatment ) ) + 
   ## Violin 
   geom_violin( trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.65, width = 0.8, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8 ) + 
   
   ## Individual observations
   geom_jitter( aes( fill = Treatment ), width = 0.12, shape = 21, color = "black", 
                stroke = 0.6, size = ifelse( plot_level == "patient", 3.2, 1.8 ), alpha = 0.9 ) + 
   
   ## Treatment colors
   scale_fill_manual( values = plot_colors ) + 
   
   ## Facet by disease 
   facet_wrap( ~ Disease ) + 
   
   ## Labels 
   labs( title = f, y = "Z-scored log intensity", x = "Treatment", fill = "Treatment" ) + 
   
   ## Theme
   theme_bw( base_size = 18 ) + theme( plot.title = element_text( size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5 ), 
                                       axis.title = element_text( size = 18, face = "bold" ), 
                                       axis.text.x = element_text( size = 16, angle = 45, hjust = 1 ), 
                                       strip.text = element_text( size = 18, face = "bold" ), panel.grid = element_blank() ) 
 
 ## ========================================================== 
 ## 5. Add statistics 
 ## ========================================================== 
 if ( !is.null(stat.test) && nrow(stat.test) > 0 ) 
 { p <- p + stat_pvalue_manual( stat.test, label = "p.signif", 
                                  size = 5, tip.length = 0.01, bracket.size = 0.6 ) } 
 
 ## ========================================================== 
 ## 6. Print 
 ## ========================================================== 
 print(p) 
 
 ## ========================================================== 
 ## 7. Save 
 ## ========================================================== 
 ggsave( file.path( outdir, paste0( gsub( "[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", f ), ".pdf" ) ), p, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300 ) 
 }

```

#correlation plot

```{r}

intensity_data <- as.data.frame(t(assay(sce, "tfmfeatures")))
intensity_features <- c(
  "Intensity_MeanIntensity_CorrLipid", 
  "Intensity_MeanIntensity_CorrLyso", 
  "Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_CorrLipid",
  "Intensity_IntegratedIntensity_CorrLyso"
)
intensity_data <- intensity_data[, intensity_features, drop = FALSE]

metadata <- as.data.frame(colData(sce)[, c("Patient", "Treatment", "Disease", "Joint", "Plate")])
df <- cbind(metadata, intensity_data)

df_corr <- df %>%
  filter(Disease == "healthy") %>%
  filter(Treatment %in% c("cont", "R+C")) %>%  # <--- keep only these two groups
  select(Treatment, Intensity_MeanIntensity_CorrCytoID, Intensity_MeanIntensity_CorrLyso)

set2_colors <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = length(unique(df_corr$Treatment)), name = "Set2")

custom_colors <- c("cont" = set2_colors[1], "R+C" = set2_colors[3])

# --- Scatter plot with correlation test ---
p_corr <- ggpubr::ggscatter(
  df_corr,
  x = "Intensity_MeanIntensity_CorrCytoID",
  y = "Intensity_MeanIntensity_CorrLyso",
  color = "Treatment",
  palette = custom_colors,
  add = "reg.line",
  conf.int = TRUE,
  cor.coef = TRUE,
  cor.method = "spearman",
  add.params = list(color = "gray30", fill = "lightgray"),
  cor.coef.size = 6,   # Increase font size of correlation text
  cor.coeff.args = list(
    label.x.npc = "center",  # Horizontal position ("left", "center", or "right")
    label.y.npc = "top",  # Vertical position ("bottom", "center", or "top")
    color = "black",         # Optional: set color of correlation label
    fontface = "bold"        # Optional: make it bold
  ),
  xlab = "Mean Intensity (CytoID)",
  ylab = "Mean Intensity (Lyso)",
  title = "Correlation between CytoID and Lyso intensities (Healthy)"
) +
  facet_wrap(~Treatment) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p_corr)

ggsave(
  filename = "Correlation_CytoID_Lyso_Healthy.pdf",
  plot = p_corr,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  units = "in"
)

```
# for C75 experiment

```{r}
## ============================================================
## 1. Select lipid features
## ============================================================

all_feature_names <- rownames(
  assay(sce_aggr, "tfmfeatures")
)

my_features <- all_feature_names[
  grepl("EdU", all_feature_names, ignore.case = TRUE) &
    (
      grepl("MeanIntensity", all_feature_names, ignore.case = TRUE) |
         #grepl("MaxIntensity", all_feature_names, ignore.case = TRUE) |
      grepl("IntegratedIntensity", all_feature_names, ignore.case = TRUE)
    )
]

cat("Selected features:\n")
print(my_features)

all_features <- my_features


## ============================================================
## 2. Choose plotting level
## ============================================================

plot_level <- "patient"

cytokines_to_plot <- c(
  "control",
  "IL1",
  "IL6",
  "TGFb"
)
# "IL1",
#   "IL6",
#   

diseases_to_plot <- c(
  "OA",
  "RA"
)

c75_levels <- c(
  "0",
  "1",
  "10"
)


## ============================================================
## 3. Extract feature data
## ============================================================

feature_data <- as.data.frame(
  t(assay(sce_aggr, "tfmfeatures"))
)

feature_data <- feature_data[
  ,
  all_features,
  drop = FALSE
]


## ============================================================
## 4. Extract metadata
## ============================================================

metadata <- as.data.frame(
  colData(sce_aggr)[,
    c(
      "Well",
      "Patient",
      "Cytokine",
      "C75",
      "Disease"
    )
  ]
)


## ============================================================
## 5. Combine metadata + features
## ============================================================

df <- cbind(
  metadata,
  feature_data
)


## ============================================================
## 6. Convert to long format
## ============================================================

df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(all_features),
    names_to = "Feature",
    values_to = "Intensity"
  )


## ============================================================
## 7. Select experiment
## ============================================================

df_plot_ready <- df_long %>%
  filter(
    Cytokine %in% cytokines_to_plot,
    Disease %in% diseases_to_plot,
    as.character(C75) %in% c75_levels
  )


## ============================================================
## 8. Patient-level aggregation
## ============================================================

if (plot_level == "patient") {

  df_plot_ready <- df_plot_ready %>%
    group_by(
      Patient,
      Disease,
      Cytokine,
      C75,                 
      Feature
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      Intensity = mean(
        Intensity,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}


## ============================================================
## 9. Factor order
## ============================================================

df_plot_ready$Cytokine <- factor(
  df_plot_ready$Cytokine,
  levels = cytokines_to_plot
)

df_plot_ready$C75 <- factor(
  as.character(df_plot_ready$C75),
  levels = c75_levels
)

df_plot_ready$Disease <- factor(
  df_plot_ready$Disease,
  levels = diseases_to_plot
)


## ============================================================
## 10. Check the data before plotting
## ============================================================

cat("\nNumber of rows:", nrow(df_plot_ready), "\n")

cat("\nCytokine:\n")
print(table(df_plot_ready$Cytokine, useNA = "ifany"))

cat("\nC75:\n")
print(table(df_plot_ready$C75, useNA = "ifany"))

cat("\nDisease:\n")
print(table(df_plot_ready$Disease, useNA = "ifany"))

cat("\nPatient × Cytokine × C75:\n")

print(
  df_plot_ready %>%
    distinct(
      Patient,
      Disease,
      Cytokine,
      C75
    ) %>%
    count(
      Disease,
      Cytokine,
      C75
    )
)


## ============================================================
## 11. Colors
## ============================================================

c75_colors <- c(
  "0"  = "#BFBFBF",
  "1"  = "#70AD47",
  "10" = "#C55A11"
)


## ============================================================
## 12. Output directory
## ============================================================

outdir <- paste0(
  "Flexible_Plots_EdU_C75_",
  plot_level
)

dir.create(
  outdir,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


## ============================================================
## 13. Loop over features
## ============================================================

for (f in unique(df_plot_ready$Feature)) {

  ## ==========================================================
  ## Data for this feature
  ## ==========================================================

  df_plot <- df_plot_ready %>%
    filter(
      Feature == f
    )


  ## ==========================================================
  ## Statistics
  ## Compare C75 0 vs 1 and 0 vs 10
  ## within each Cytokine and Disease
  ## ==========================================================

  comparisons <- list(
    c("0", "1"),
    c("0", "10")
  )

  stat_result <- df_plot %>%
    group_by(
      Disease,
      Cytokine
    ) %>%
    wilcox_test(
      Intensity ~ C75,
      comparisons = comparisons,
      paired = TRUE,
      id = "Patient",
      p.adjust.method = "holm"
    )


  ## ==========================================================
  ## Format p-values
  ## ==========================================================

  stat.test <- stat_result %>%
    mutate(
      p.signif = case_when(
        p.adj <= 0.001 ~ "***",
        p.adj <= 0.01  ~ "**",
        p.adj <= 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ paste0(
          "p = ",
          signif(p.adj, 2)
        )
      )
    )


  ## ==========================================================
  ## Y positions
  ## ==========================================================

  y_max <- df_plot %>%
    group_by(
      Disease,
      Cytokine
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      ymax = max(
        Intensity,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  stat.test <- stat.test %>%
    left_join(
      y_max,
      by = c(
        "Disease",
        "Cytokine"
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      Disease,
      Cytokine
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      y.position =
        ymax +
        row_number() * 0.3
    ) %>%
    ungroup()


  ## ==========================================================
  ## X positions for brackets
  ## ==========================================================

  ## Cytokine positions:
  ## control = 1
  ## IL1     = 2
  ## IL6     = 3
  ## TGFb    = 4

  cytokine_position <- tibble(
    Cytokine = factor(
      cytokines_to_plot,
      levels = cytokines_to_plot
    ),
    x_center = seq_along(
      cytokines_to_plot
    )
  )

  stat.test <- stat.test %>%
    left_join(
      cytokine_position,
      by = "Cytokine"
    ) %>%
    mutate(

      ## position of C75 groups within each cytokine
      xmin = case_when(
        group1 == "0" ~ x_center - 0.27,
        group1 == "1" ~ x_center,
        group1 == "10" ~ x_center + 0.27
      ),

      xmax = case_when(
        group2 == "0" ~ x_center - 0.27,
        group2 == "1" ~ x_center,
        group2 == "10" ~ x_center + 0.27
      )
    )


  ## ==========================================================
  ## Plot
  ## ==========================================================

  p <- ggplot(
    df_plot,
    aes(
      x = Cytokine,
      y = Intensity,
      fill = C75
    )
  ) +

    ## Violin
    geom_violin(
      trim = FALSE,
      alpha = 0.65,
      width = 0.8,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.8,
      position = position_dodge(
        width = 0.8
      )
    ) +

    ## Individual patient observations
    geom_jitter(
      position = position_jitterdodge(
        jitter.width = 0.12,
        dodge.width = 0.8
      ),
      shape = 21,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 0.6,
      size = ifelse(
        plot_level == "patient",
        3.2,
        1.8
      ),
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +

    ## C75 colors
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c75_colors,
      labels = c(
        "0"  = "0 µM",
        "1"  = "1 µM",
        "10" = "10 µM"
      ),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +

    ## Disease facets
    facet_wrap(
      ~ Disease
    ) +

    ## Labels
    labs(
      title = f,
      y = "Z-scored log intensity",
      x = "Cytokine",
      fill = "C75"
    ) +

    ## Theme
    theme_bw(
      base_size = 18
    ) +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 16,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(
        size = 18,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 16
      ),
      strip.text = element_text(
        size = 18,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )


  ## ==========================================================
  ## Add statistics
  ## ==========================================================

  if (
    !is.null(stat.test) &&
    nrow(stat.test) > 0
  ) {

    p <- p +
      stat_pvalue_manual(
        stat.test,
        label = "p.signif",
        xmin = "xmin",
        xmax = "xmax",
        y.position = "y.position",
        size = 5,
        tip.length = 0.01,
        bracket.size = 0.6
      )
  }


  ## ==========================================================
  ## Print
  ## ==========================================================

  print(p)


  ## ==========================================================
  ## Save
  ## ==========================================================

  ggsave(
    file.path(
      outdir,
      paste0(
        gsub(
          "[^A-Za-z0-9_]+",
          "_",
          f
        ),
        ".pdf"
      )
    ),
    p,
    width = 10,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 1. Extract EdU intensity + metadata
# ============================================================

df <- data.frame(
  EdU = as.numeric(
    assay(sce, "tfmfeatures")[
      "Intensity_MeanIntensity_CorrEdU",
      ,
      drop = TRUE
    ]
  ),
  colData(sce)
)

# Remove NA / Inf
df <- df %>%
  filter(is.finite(EdU))


# ============================================================
# 2. Define EdU-positive cells
# ============================================================

cutoff <- 1

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    EdU_positive = EdU > cutoff
  )


# ============================================================
# 3. Calculate % EdU-positive per patient
#    Combine all C75 doses
# ============================================================
df_patient <- df %>%
  group_by(
    Patient,
    Disease,
    Cytokine,
    C75       
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cells = n(),
    n_positive = sum(EdU > 1),
    pct_EdU_positive = 100 * n_positive / n_cells,
    .groups = "drop"
  )



# ==========================================================
# 1. Define cytokine conditions
# ==========================================================

cytokines <- c("control", "IL1", "IL6", "TGFb")

# Cytokines to make separate graphs for
stimulated_cytokines <- c("IL1", "IL6", "TGFb")


# ==========================================================
# 2. Keep only C75 doses of interest
# ==========================================================

df_patient <- df_patient %>%
  filter(
    C75 %in% c(0, 1, 10),
    Cytokine %in% cytokines
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    C75 = factor(
      C75,
      levels = c(0, 1, 10),
      labels = c("0", "1", "10")
    )
  )

control <- df_patient %>%
  filter(Cytokine == "control") %>%
  crossing(
    Comparison = stimulated_cytokines
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = "Control"
  )


# ==========================================================
# 4. Get cytokine-treated samples
# ==========================================================

stim <- df_patient %>%
  filter(
    Cytokine %in% stimulated_cytokines
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Comparison = Cytokine,
    Condition = Cytokine
  )


# ==========================================================
# 5. Combine Control + cytokine
# ==========================================================

df_compare <- bind_rows(
  control,
  stim
)


# ==========================================================
# 6. Plot one separate graph for each cytokine
# ==========================================================

for (cyt in stimulated_cytokines) {

  df_plot <- df_compare %>%
    filter(Comparison == cyt)

  p <- ggplot(
    df_plot,
    aes(
      x = C75,
      y = pct_EdU_positive,
      color = Condition,
      group = interaction(Patient, Condition)
    )
  ) +

    # Connect each patient's measurements across C75 doses
    geom_line(
      alpha = 0.4,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    # Individual patient dots
    geom_point(
      size = 2.5
    ) +

    # OA and RA side-by-side
    facet_wrap(
      ~ Disease,
      ncol = 2
    ) +

    theme_classic() +

    labs(
      title = paste("Control vs", cyt),
      x = "C75 dose (µM)",
      y = "% EdU-positive cells",
      color = NULL
    )

  print(p)
}
```

detect EdU cutoff 

```{r}
tb_sce <- lapply(c("tfmfeatures"), function(assay_type) {
    makePerCellDF(
        sce,
        assay.type = assay_type,
        features = "Intensity_MeanIntensity_CorrEdU"
    ) |>
        mutate(
            Assay = assay_type,
            Patient = factor(Patient)
        )
}) |> bind_rows()

# ============================================================
# 1. Function to find cutoff between peak 1 and peak 2
# ============================================================
find_valley_cutoff <- function(
    x,
    n = 2048,
    adjust = 1.5,
    min_peak_height = 0.20,
    min_peak_distance = 0.5
) {

  x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  if (length(x) < 20) {
    return(data.frame(
      cutoff = NA_real_,
      peak1 = NA_real_,
      peak2 = NA_real_,
      n_peaks = 0,
      method = "too_few_cells",
      n_cells = length(x)
    ))
  }

  d <- density(
    x,
    n = n,
    adjust = adjust
  )

  dx <- d$x[2] - d$x[1]

  peaks <- findpeaks(
    d$y,
    minpeakheight = max(d$y) * min_peak_height,
    minpeakdistance = round(min_peak_distance / dx)
  )

  if (is.null(peaks)) {
    return(data.frame(
      cutoff = NA_real_,
      peak1 = NA_real_,
      peak2 = NA_real_,
      n_peaks = 0,
      method = "no_peak",
      n_cells = length(x)
    ))
  }

  peak_idx <- peaks[, 2]

  peak_idx <- peak_idx[
    order(d$x[peak_idx])
  ]

  n_peaks <- length(peak_idx)

  peak1_idx <- peak_idx[1]
  peak1 <- d$x[peak1_idx]

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # TWO OR MORE PEAKS
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (n_peaks >= 2) {

    peak2_idx <- peak_idx[2]
    peak2 <- d$x[peak2_idx]

    between <- peak1_idx:peak2_idx

    valley_idx <- between[
      which.min(d$y[between])
    ]

    cutoff <- d$x[valley_idx]

    return(data.frame(
      cutoff = cutoff,
      peak1 = peak1,
      peak2 = peak2,
      n_peaks = n_peaks,
      method = "valley_between_peak1_peak2",
      n_cells = length(x)
    ))
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # ONLY ONE PEAK
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  cutoff <- peak1 + 0.6

  data.frame(
    cutoff = cutoff,
    peak1 = peak1,
    peak2 = NA_real_,
    n_peaks = 1,
    method = "immediately_after_peak1",
    n_cells = length(x)
  )
}

cutoff_table <- tb_sce %>%
  group_by(Patient, Cytokine, C75) %>%
  group_modify(~ find_valley_cutoff(
    .x$Intensity_MeanIntensity_CorrEdU
  )) %>%
  ungroup()

cutoff_table

# see plot for 1 patient

patient <- unique(tb_sce$Patient)[2]

df_plot <- tb_sce %>%
  filter(Patient == patient)

df_cutoff <- cutoff_table %>%
  filter(Patient == patient)

p <- ggplot(
  df_plot,
  aes(x = Intensity_MeanIntensity_CorrEdU)
) +
  geom_density(
    linewidth = 1
  ) +

  # RED = cutoff
  geom_vline(
    data = df_cutoff %>%
      filter(is.finite(cutoff)),
    aes(xintercept = cutoff),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1,
    color = "red"
  ) +

  # BLUE = first peak
  geom_vline(
    data = df_cutoff %>%
      filter(is.finite(peak1)),
    aes(xintercept = peak1),
    linetype = "dotted",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    color = "blue"
  ) +

  # GREEN = second peak
  geom_vline(
    data = df_cutoff %>%
      filter(is.finite(peak2)),
    aes(xintercept = peak2),
    linetype = "dotted",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    color = "darkgreen"
  ) +

  facet_grid(
    Cytokine ~ C75
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(-2, 5)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = paste("Patient:", patient),
    x = "Intensity_MeanIntensity_CorrEdU",
    y = "Density"
  ) +

  theme_classic()

print(p)
```

Calculate EdU-positive cells
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Calculate % EdU positive per Patient × Cytokine × C75
# ============================================================

edu_positive <- tb_sce %>%
  left_join(
    cutoff_table %>%
      select(Patient, Cytokine, C75, cutoff),
    by = c("Patient", "Cytokine", "C75")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    EdU_positive = Intensity_MeanIntensity_CorrEdU >= cutoff
  )

edu_patient <- edu_positive %>%
  group_by(Patient, Cytokine, C75) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cells = n(),
    n_positive = sum(EdU_positive, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_positive = 100 * mean(EdU_positive, na.rm = TRUE),
    cutoff = first(cutoff),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

edu_patient

edu_summary <- edu_patient %>%
  group_by(Cytokine, C75) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_percent = mean(percent_positive, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_percent = sd(percent_positive, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_patients = sum(is.finite(percent_positive)),
    sem_percent = sd_percent / sqrt(n_patients),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_edu <- ggplot(
  edu_summary,
  aes(x = Cytokine, y = mean_percent)
) +

  # Mean bar
  geom_col(
    width = 0.7
  ) +

  # SEM
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_percent - sem_percent,
      ymax = mean_percent + sem_percent
    ),
    width = 0.2
  ) +

  # Individual patients
  geom_jitter(
    data = edu_patient,
    aes(
      x = Cytokine,
      y = percent_positive
    ),
    width = 0.12,
    height = 0,
    size = 2.5,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ C75,
    nrow = 1
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Cytokine",
    y = "EdU-positive cells (%)"
  ) +

  theme_classic()

print(p_edu)

ggsave(
  filename = "EdU_positive_C75.pdf",
  plot = p_edu,
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  units = "in"
)
```
